name: Lamashtu: The Fall
source:
The centuries-long conflict between the Neo-Terran Confederacy and the Alliance of Free Planets is at its climax. FSS Lamashtu, new experimental cruiser of the Alliance's navy, prepares for its maiden voyage. However, the captain of the ship might have his own nefarious designs...

[From [url=https://tjord.itch.io/lamashtu-the-fall]itch.io[/url]]
